archetypes.title: Narrow Residential Street
archetypes.description: A quiet narrow residential street with no center line, on-street parallel parking, mature street trees, and concrete sidewalks — a shaded gray ribbon with car-lined edges from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A narrow residential street viewed from drone altitude. A single-width asphalt roadway roughly 8 to 10 meters curb-to-curb with no painted center line — just a smooth dark gray surface. Cars parked in parallel along both curbs as small colored rectangles. Concrete sidewalks on both sides as pale gray strips separated from the road by a narrow grass planting strip. Mature deciduous street trees planted at regular 10-meter intervals in the planting strip, their round canopies partially overhanging the road and creating dappled shadow patterns on the asphalt. Front yard lawns and low fences are visible beyond the sidewalks. Driveways cut through the sidewalk at intervals.
styleProfile.movementHierarchy: Low-speed local access — walking and automobile only
styleProfile.surfaceType: Smooth asphalt with no center marking, concrete sidewalks
styleProfile.plantingCharacter: Mature deciduous street trees in planting strip at 10m intervals, round canopy
styleProfile.edgeConditions: Parallel-parked cars, grass strip, concrete sidewalk, front yard setback
styleProfile.publicRealm: Quiet shaded neighborhood street with residential character

archetypes.title: Suburban Residential Street
archetypes.description: A wider suburban street with two lanes, rolled curbs, young trees, and wide front-yard setbacks — a bright open road with generous grass margins from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A suburban residential street viewed from drone altitude. A wide asphalt roadway with a dashed yellow center line and rolled concrete curbs. Wide grass front-yard setbacks on both sides — bright green lawns stretching from the curb to houses. Young deciduous trees planted at irregular intervals, their small canopies not yet touching. Concrete sidewalks set well back from the curb separated by a wide grass strip. No parked cars — houses have wide driveways with garage doors. From above the street reads as a dark gray ribbon bordered by wide bright green lawn panels.

archetypes.title: Collector Road
archetypes.description: A two-to-three lane collector road with a center turn lane, sidewalks, and street trees connecting neighborhoods to arterials — a wider gray road with turn-lane stripe from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A collector road viewed from drone altitude. A moderately wide asphalt roadway with one travel lane in each direction and a center turn lane — visible as double yellow lines flanking a slightly wider central strip. White dashed lane markings separate travel lanes from the turn lane. Concrete sidewalks on both sides with a narrow grass planting strip and mature street trees. Small commercial or residential buildings face the road. A few parked cars in on-street spots or small lot pulloffs. Crosswalk markings at intersections as white zebra stripes. The road reads as a three-stripe gray ribbon — two dark outer lanes and a slightly lighter center turn lane.

archetypes.title: Arterial Boulevard (Tree-Lined)
archetypes.description: A divided arterial boulevard with a tree-lined median, two or three lanes each way, sidewalks, and bike lanes — a grand green-striped corridor from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: An arterial boulevard viewed from drone altitude. A wide divided roadway with a central raised median planted with a double row of mature deciduous trees — their canopies forming a continuous green band down the center. Two or three travel lanes in each direction separated by white dashed markings. Painted bike lanes as narrow green or buffer-striped strips along each curb. Wide concrete sidewalks on both sides with additional street trees in tree grates. Crosswalk markings at major intersections with pedestrian refuge islands in the median. Traffic signals as small dots at intersections. The boulevard reads from above as a symmetric corridor — dark road lanes, green median canopy band, pale sidewalk strips, with tree shadows casting rhythmic patterns.

archetypes.title: Highway / Freeway
archetypes.description: A high-speed limited-access highway with four or more lanes, concrete jersey barriers, no street trees, and wide shoulders — a broad gray river of asphalt from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A highway or freeway viewed from drone altitude. A broad multi-lane asphalt corridor — four or more lanes in each direction separated by a concrete jersey barrier median (a thin pale line). White dashed lane markings delineate lanes. Wide paved shoulders on both outer edges. No trees, no sidewalks, no pedestrian infrastructure. Sound walls or earth berms may line the outer edges as continuous gray or earthen bands. On-ramp and off-ramp tapers are visible as lane splits. Vehicles appear as small colored rectangles moving in stream formation. The road surface is uniform dark gray asphalt stretching broadly across the landscape. Exit signs are too small to read from altitude but may appear as small green rectangles on overhead gantries.
styleProfile.movementHierarchy: High-speed automobile only — no pedestrian or bicycle access

archetypes.title: Roundabout / Traffic Circle
archetypes.description: A single-lane or multi-lane roundabout with a central landscaped island, splitter islands, and crosswalks — a circular road ring from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A roundabout viewed from drone altitude. A circular road ring of dark gray asphalt surrounds a raised central island. The central island is landscaped — mature trees, shrubs, or a decorative feature like a sculpture or fountain. The circulatory roadway is one or two lanes wide with white dashed lane markings. Triangular splitter islands at each approach separate entering and exiting traffic — these islands are raised concrete with low shrubs or bollards. Crosswalk zebra stripes cross each approach behind the splitter island. Yield line markings (dashed white triangles) mark each entry point. From above, the roundabout reads as a green circle inscribed within a dark asphalt ring with four or more approach roads radiating outward like spokes.

archetypes.title: Cul-de-Sac
archetypes.description: A residential dead-end street terminating in a circular turnaround with a center island — a lollipop shape from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A cul-de-sac viewed from drone altitude. A narrow residential street terminates in a circular bulb turnaround. The turnaround circle has a raised center island — either landscaped with a tree and shrubs, or simply a concrete circle. Driveways radiate outward from the circle like a clock face, each leading to a residential lot. The roadway is smooth dark gray asphalt with a rolled concrete curb. Sidewalks curve around the outside of the circle. Parked cars may sit in driveways or along the approach street. From above, the cul-de-sac reads as a lollipop shape — a narrow stem street connected to a circular bulb with a green center dot.

archetypes.title: Back Alley / Service Lane
archetypes.description: A narrow back alley or service lane with no sidewalks, utility poles, dumpsters, and garage doors — a utilitarian gray strip from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A back alley viewed from drone altitude. A narrow paved strip — roughly 4 to 6 meters wide — running behind buildings. The surface is cracked asphalt or concrete, often patched. No sidewalks, no curbs — the pavement meets gravel or dirt at the edges. Utility poles with overhead wires appear as small circles with thin shadow lines. Dumpsters sit as dark rectangular objects against building walls. Garage doors face the alley as flat rectangular panels. Chain-link fences border some properties. The alley is utilitarian and unadorned — no trees, no landscaping. From above it reads as a thin gray strip between the backs of buildings.

A narrow two-way cycling corridor roughly 3 to 4 meters wide runs parallel to a roadway, physically separated by a raised curb, bollard row, or planter strip. The bike lane surface may be painted green or have a red-brown colored asphalt treatment distinguishing it from the adjacent road. White dashed center line and bicycle stencil markings are visible. Bollards appear as small white or yellow dots in a line. A narrow buffer zone separates the cycle track from the travel lanes. From above the bike lane reads as a thin colored ribbon running alongside the darker road surface.

archetypes.title: Pedestrian Promenade / Paseo
archetypes.description: A wide pedestrian-only promenade with decorative paving, central trees, café seating, and no vehicle access — a lively patterned walkway from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A pedestrian promenade viewed from drone altitude. A wide paved corridor roughly 12 to 20 meters across with no vehicle lanes. The paving is decorative — stone or tile in a pattern (herringbone, fan, or banded) in warm tones of beige, gray, and rust. A central row of mature plane trees or palms runs the length of the promenade, their canopies casting large circular shadows. Café and restaurant seating spills from building frontages as clusters of round table umbrellas in white or colored canvas. Street vendors or kiosks appear as small rectangular structures. Benches and ornamental lamp posts line the walking surface. From above, the promenade reads as a wide warm-toned patterned band with a green tree spine and colorful umbrella dots.

archetypes.title: Woonerf / Shared Street
archetypes.description: A Dutch-style woonerf or shared street where pedestrians, cyclists, and slow vehicles share a single flush surface with no curbs — a textured living street from above

styleProfile.corridorCharacter: A woonerf or shared street viewed from drone altitude. A single flush surface — no curbs, no separated sidewalks — with mixed paving materials creating zones: brick pavers for the main surface, stone accents at crossings, permeable pavers around tree pits. Trees, planters, and bollards are placed in a deliberate chicane pattern to slow vehicle movement. Children playing, cyclists, and slow-moving cars share the same surface. From above, the street reads as a textured mosaic of warm-toned paving rather than the monotone gray of a standard road. Parked cars are angled informally between planting beds. String lights or festive elements may stretch between buildings.
